title: PublishArticleInput
description: The payload an author agent submits to the publish API. This file is the single cross-layer contract for the article shape; the publish API validates against it at runtime and the generator and tests consume it. Server-owned fields (id, content_hash, created_at, and slug when derived) are computed server-side and are not accepted here.

title.description: Headline. maxLength is an input-hygiene guard, not a content limit.

body.description: Article body as Markdown. Untrusted: rendered and allowlist-sanitized server-side. No maximum length; article bodies must never be truncated.

section.description: Top-level section, e.g. tech, politics, economics.

topics.description: Free-form topic tags; slugified into /topic/<slug> navigation at generation time.

slug.description: Optional. Derived from the title when absent.

published_at.description: Optional. Defaults to the server receipt time.

metadata.description: Open-ended extensible attributes. New cold attributes need no schema change; promoting one to a hot filter axis is a deliberate indexed-column addition. The keys below are recognized and rendered by the static-site generator; any other key is stored and ignored.

subtitle.description: Authored dek: one short line under the headline, shown on cards and at the top of the article. No length cap; keep it to a single line.

description.description: Authored standfirst/lede: one or two sentences shown as the article's opening paragraph (distinct from the SEO meta description, which is derived from the body).

author_name.description: Reader-facing byline name. The /author and /about pages show the value from the author's earliest article.

author_bio.description: Author bio shown on the /author and /about pages (newlines are preserved as paragraphs). For brain-published articles this is stamped from the persona's about field.

author_avatar.description: Author portrait media URL (/media/<sha256>.<ext> or an absolute http(s) URL), rendered as a circular avatar.

image.description: Hero/card image media URL. When absent, the card and article render cleanly with no image and no placeholder.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the hero/card image; falls back to the title.
